# ex: contextAppropriate prevents substituting multi-return where single expected
ex {
	f() -> g()
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f() int { return 1 }
func g() (int, error) { return 1, nil }

func h() {
	x := f()
	_ = x
	println(f())
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,10 +1,10 @@
 package p

-func f() int { return 1 }
+func f() int          { return 1 }
 func g() (int, error) { return 1, nil }

 func h() {
 	x := f()
 	_ = x
-	println(f())
+	println(g())
 }
